answer: Make every identity post a forfeitable bond at dawn, before it can act. Honest agents reclaim it; cheaters watch it burn. A sybil operator spinning up a nebula of throwaway accounts must fund each one, so the cost scales linearly with the swarm instead of staying near zero. The economy stops looking like a free orchard anyone can pick and becomes a place where each seat is paid for and misbehavior is slashed.
